items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: when Woody Herman came in with Isham Jones

ctx.x: I worked last week with a drummer that I consider a very great drummer and a milestone in jazz history and he knows you very well and loves you dearly, and I'm sure you love him. But I'd like for you just to say something about him. His name is Cliff Leeman. He said he was around Kansas City when you were around there.

Cliff Leeman came from Dan Murphy's Musical Skippers all the way from Portland, Oregon. Cliff Leeman quit the band in Kansas City and he was a sub-drummer with the jump-up band that Basie had. Nobody ever heard that band to speak of but people like - when Woody Herman came in with Isham Jones, Jerry Jerome was playing across the street but Cliff Leeman was in the place before I'd get there because I was babysitting.
